findings.title: A shared practice rather than a flat list
findings.claim: The exception's believing group can be read as an interdependent public practice: belief is enacted in work, soundness repairs, reciprocal counsel carries a common standard, and patience sustains it.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies six distinct carriers; wider parallels place belief beside communal patience and mercy (90:17), action in cooperation (5:2), repair between people (8:1), truth amid disagreement (2:213), public communal exhortation (3:104), and collective perseverance (3:200). The two repeated tawāṣaw clauses connect these functions into a shared discipline.
findings.reader_payoff: The sequence becomes a set of mutually sustaining practices rather than a list of private virtues.
findings.containment: The connections support an interdependent reading but do not prove that each practice causally guarantees every other or establish a single cross-surah system. The focus still names the conditions of the exception.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch records and cross-run publication are supplied; the external rows include exact Arabic and connection notes but omit target morphology. The system-level integration is therefore stated as a bounded reading.
